title: A bounded Borel field W, a.e. tangent to M, with ξ(β∧ω) = β(W) a.e. on M
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set, let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity triple in U of dimension n+1 (IMRep U (n+1), with M = R.carrier and ξ = R.orient), let ω : ℝ^P → Λⁿ(ℝ^P) be a continuous n-form (DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n), and let B ∈ ℝ satisfy ‖ω(x)‖ ≤ B for all x. Then there exist a Borel measurable W : ℝ^P → ℝ^P and c′ ∈ ℝ such that: W(x) = 0 whenever ω(x) = 0; ‖W(x)‖ ≤ c′ for all x; and for H^{n+1}-a.e. x ∈ M (μHE[n+1].restrict M; one null set for all β), W(x) ∈ T_xM := approxTangentPlane (n+1) M x and, for every 1-covector β : ℝ^P →L[ℝ] ℝ, ξ(x)(β∧ω(x)) = β(W(x)), where β∧ω(x) := alternatizeUncurryFin(β.smulRight ω(x)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U (n + 1)) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (B : ℝ), Continuous ω → (∀ x, ‖ω x‖ ≤ B) → ∃ (W : Euclid P → Euclid P) (c' : ℝ), Measurable W ∧ (∀ x, ω x = 0 → W x = 0) ∧ (∀ x, ‖W x‖ ≤ c') ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n + 1].restrict R.carrier), W x ∈ approxTangentPlane (n + 1) R.carrier x ∧ ∀ β : Euclid P →L[ℝ] ℝ, R.orient x (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin (β.smulRight (ω x))) = β (W x)
